candidates.change_summary: Change the required call selector from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,address,uint256), so the encoded selector differs and calls a different function on caddress.
Change the call to use staticcall instead of call, which can cause different return behavior (staticcall will revert if the target attempts state changes).
Invert the require on _s to require(!_s) so the function will require failure of the external call, changing return behavior when calls succeed.
Remove the require(_tos.length > 0) check, allowing empty arrays and changing return behavior for that input.
Return false instead of true at the end of the function, changing the returned value observable at the public surface when execution completes.
